title: I work at mall world.
content: I dream of working at a salon in mall world almost every night. I open the salon and turn on the lights, answer phones and book appointments, greet customers, sell products, put cash in a register, etc. nothing out of the ordinary ever happens. It truly feels like an alternate universe I slip into. Does anyone else have a job in mall world? Has anyone been to the salon? I’ve met a lot of people there. The salon has dim lighting, a big glass window at the entrance, tv in the waiting area, and about six stations.
